No assertions/timeouts/baselines changed; no baseline entries; sase-1a7 left open. Evidence: new test_stalled_navigation_resumes_on_scroll_extent_growth FAILS before (anchor_wait scroll_y=0 target=6 max=54 pending=1 retry=8) PASSES after. Isolated 50x each, both venvs (3.14/8.0.1 and scratch 3.12/8.2.8 outside repo per plan): regression 50/50+50/50, ctrl_j 50/50+50/50, superseding 50/50+50/50. Loaded decks-dir -n6 +48 spinners: 4/5 clean per venv; each single flake shows max_scroll_y=0 at timeout (extent never grew in-window under contention) and the same signature reproduces on the clean base tree (ctrl_j + late_layout fail there too), so it is the known pre-existing wait-vs-layout race, not a regression; scheduled Full CI proof stays with the land agent. sase tool run check: ruff/mypy/test-waits/changelog/terminology/docs/scoped-tests green; only 9 KNOWN pre-existing symvision in untouched files (verdict no_new_failures).
